description:
Hi,

Greetings

Hope you are doing great!

I would like to update you on an urgent open position with our esteemed client. Please go through the Job Description. Send me your updated resume and expected rate for the below position

Role: Technology Analyst - Java/J2EE, Angular.JS and UI Skills
Duration: Full Time
Location: Bothell, WA

Qualifications
Basic
 
• Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education
• At least 2-3 years of experience with Information Technology

Preferred
• Must have Java (core Java with mandatory on Servlets, Filters), JS, JQuery, HTML5, CSS competencies.
• Competency in Angular.JS 1.5 or above is a must
• Expertise in micro services , Spring boot, app memory management, multithreading, networking & Security
• Should have good competency in hybrid apps with some experience in native app design and development (Android and iOS). The Dev lead won’t be writing native app code, but they will be 
 interfacing with the team that does, hence some experience may be beneficial.
•Candidate should also be able to demonstrate high competency in OAuth
•Experience in leading a small group of team members
•Solid understanding of software design and patterns like - MVC, Delegation, Singleton, Factory, Adapter
•Familiarity with agile development/waterfall processes and methodologies
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Analytical skills 
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment


 • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
